title: Reproducible worklet bundle and versioned RPC contract
approved_scope: Add bare-pack and bare-rpc dependencies plus a deterministic worklet build and drift-check command.
Add the typed versioned host/worklet protocol, runtime validators, compatible handshake, bounded ping, fatal receipt, suspend/resume lifecycle messages, timeout handling, and clean shutdown.
Modify only the seven frozen source/test paths and P1.F1 evidence/status artifacts listed by the approved card.
excluded_scope: App or provider composition, RootNavigator changes, P0 scaffold deletion, and later P1 child work.
Hyperdrive, Corestore, Hyperswarm, discovery, networking, fixture storage, product API/UI, backend, HTTP/HLS, and iOS.
Commits, pushes, deployment, or any external write.
acceptance: HP-F1: deterministic bundle generation plus a compatible handshake returns protocol/runtime capabilities and preserves bounded ping and clean shutdown.
EC-F1: bundle drift, unsupported version, malformed payload, timeout, uncaught exception or rejection, and invalid lifecycle messages fail typed, redacted, and without retained pending work.

Source-to-bundle drift, dependency and bundle digests, focused/full Jest, typecheck, lint, three Reflection passes, coverage certification, owner verification, and status synchronization are recorded.
constraints: Keep the P0 characterization scaffold unchanged until separately gated P1.F3a and P1.F3b.
Use bare-rpc beneath a small DubBridge-owned versioned application protocol with runtime validation.
Install worklet fatal handlers and keep errors typed and redacted.
Stop and return to scoring/review/approval if the implementation requires any path or behavior outside the frozen P1.F1 boundary.
